title: Review of c18's flshell2 (IBMED): gliders, division to generation 3-6, and death of a food-cut daughter replicate on fresh seeds; the shell is a non-transported set-point readout of the body, so B is by construction (its only work is a 15-22% speed-up)
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seeds 41 and 42 (128^2, T=800) and the h5=0 ablation on the same seeds. Shelled gliders form from the planted noise patch, glide 10-15 body lengths, and divide to generation 3 and 6 (persistent splits 6/8, merge/split 0.81/0.78: reticulate). With the shell feedback the median top-track speed is 0.63/0.49 vs 0.52/0.43 at h5=0 (+22%/+15%), max body lengths 14.8/10.4 vs 10.0/9.4. c18's starve-one-daughter fork (scripts/dfork.py, 600 t) on fresh seeds 7, 8, 9: on seeds 8 and 9 the food-cut daughter shrinks and vanishes (first <10% at t=349 and 340, 190 and 150 t after the fork; forks/df8.png, df9.png) while its fed twin glides on and the sister grows 2.9-3.4x; seed 7 is unreadable because the nearest-centroid tracker put both markers on one body. Reading world.py: S has no transport and no conservation, it is dS/dt = 0.5 G(K_ring * A_sum) clipped to [0,1], a time-integrated band-pass readout of the body density, so per RUBRIC L3 it is a contour by construction whose ablation shows only a speed effect and no containment.

seeds_run.result: fork unreadable: tracker merged both markers on one body
pass: cut daughter dies ~190 t after fork, fed twin persists
pass: cut daughter dies ~150 t after fork, fed twin persists

controls_run.B: control_h5_0/seed41, seed42 (world_h5_0.py, h5=0): bodies keep their S ring and still glide and divide, only 15-22% slower
controls_run.E: forks/df8, df9 (fed twin vs following food cut, from identical fork states)

verdicts.limitation: B: S is not a material channel (no transport, no conservation; a set-point readout of K_ring*A), so the ring is a contour by construction; its ablation shows a modest speed effect only, it contains nothing and does not stop fusion (merges ~0.8 of splits). E counts only through the fork test, since matter is buildable only from food. D is reticulate (medium confidence) and founded from one planted 12 px noise patch. Fork tracking is nearest-centroid and failed on 1 of 3 seeds; deaths were read from the frames. No resolution or dt variant run; no Laplacian-only twin.
